x1r39nqx.author: Plato
x1r39nqx.label: The art of midwifery for souls
x1r39nqx.translation: Well, my art of midwifery is in most respects like theirs; but differs, in that I attend men and not women; and look after their souls when they are in labour, and not after their bodies: and the triumph of my art is in thoroughly examining whether the thought which the mind of the young man brings forth is a false idol or a noble and true birth. And like the midwives, I am barren, and the reproach which is often made against me, that I ask questions of others and have not the wit to answer them myself, is very just--the reason is, that the god compels me to be a midwife, but does not allow me to bring forth.
x1r39nqx.reading: Socrates' maieutic art helps what is held in potentiality pass into actuality, but the gestation must already have begun in the student. She calls the highest pregnancy that of the true self, the "birth of light", with Artemis helping you give birth to what you carry.

p1pszy7l.title: Ether meditation on the space of awareness
steps: With eyes open, observe the objects in the room and their relation to you
Shift attention from the objects to the space they sit in; notice body relax, heart open, gaze widen
Close the eyes, connect with the breath, feel the inner space
Place one short thought or image at the centre of the mind-screen and breathe with it
Shift attention from that object to the space in which it appears, which remains before and after thoughts
Recognise its qualities: vastness, openness, soft aliveness, luminosity, eternity; recognise it as the I that sees and hears
Feel that space through neck, heart, hands, torso, belly, back, legs and soles: the space breathes the body
Let body, consciousness, space and I merge into the present; inner and outer space are one
Open the eyes and keep the recognition as forms resume their play
p1pszy7l.why: Ether, the fifth element and Plato's element of the gods, is treated as space and consciousness; the practice moves from objects to the awareness that holds them.
